name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks Online as agent tools, via Intuit's OFFICIAL MCP server (github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server, Apache-2.0), pinned to commit 099351858ee696dbbeb00dc7ca8e3a86276d86bb. A thin HTTP bridge adapts its stdio MCP transport to Eesa's stateless JSON-RPC. QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE/UPDATE/DELETE decide the tool surface at container start: a disabled verb is never registered, so it cannot be called however it is asked for. Read-only is 70 tools. This deployment currently runs with write and update ENABLED (121 tools) so the Chups month-end sync can post journal entries; delete stays disabled.
